title: fix(cloud-connection): install-local answers an artifact the resolver refuses with its 422 at the declared-rename step, not a 503
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi96QpUuH77yeiDEFd5Vi6Pg1)_

Fixes #34432

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:install-local 的「声明式重命名」步骤(2c″)遇到解析器拒收的组合包(`packages` 不是数组、或某个包条目带已退役的 `indexes[].unique: true`)时，改为回答解析器自己的 422 与错误码，不再回答 503「数据库不可用、请重试」。
- 为什么改：包作者拿到的是错误归因，重试永远不会成功;同一份字节在 isolated 姿态的 2b 步骤已经回答 422,两个步骤口径不一致。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `@objectstack/cloud-connection` 一个文件的拒收答复，不写入任何数据;真正读不到表时仍回 503;未声明状态的异常(如包之间的依赖环)原样抛出。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts` 的 `evaluateDeclaredRenames` 开头新增的预解析块，以及抽出的 `declaredRefusalAnswer`(2b 与 2c″ 共用);再看新测试 `marketplace-install-local-resolver-refusal-34432.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection exec vitest run src/marketplace-install-local-resolver-refusal-34432.test.ts`,预期 5 个用例全绿(两条 422、一条 503 对照、一条 200 对照、一条依赖环原样抛出)。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Step 2c″ of `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` (`evaluateDeclaredRenames`) caught every throw out of `planDeclaredRenames` and answered it `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` "… could not be read … Retry once the database answers". That included the artifact resolver's declared `422` refusal of a composed body. The step now:

- resolves the bodies the plan reads before any table is read, through the plan's own fold (`packageUpgradeSideOf`: the `resolveStackCollection` reads of `objects`, `objectExtensions` and `data`; the installed body too on a re-install);
- answers a refusal there with that refusal's own declared status and code (`422 INVALID_ARTIFACT_PACKAGES` / `INVALID_ARTIFACT_PACKAGE_ENTRY`) and writes nothing;
- rethrows an undeclared throw out of the resolver (its dependency-cycle error, a bare `Error`), and does not relabel it;
- keeps the `503` for a throw out of the plan itself, which is now only the table read.

The reader is the one step 2b (#34428) answers the same refusal with. It is extracted within the file as `declaredRefusalAnswer(manifestId, err)`, so the two steps share one implementation and answer the same bytes with the same status, code and sentence. Step 2b's behaviour is byte-identical: same predicate (`declaredStatus === undefined || status >= 500` ⇒ rethrow), same body, same status.

Changeset: `@objectstack/cloud-connection` patch.

## Tests

New file `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-resolver-refusal-34432.test.ts`. It drives the real install route handler, under the `single` posture, with the route-handler harness that #34428 used (runtime mocked without the step-1c collectors):

- `packages: 'not-a-list'` ⇒ `422`, `error.code` `INVALID_ARTIFACT_PACKAGES`. Nothing is registered, there is no ledger entry, and the driver is never asked to read a table.
- A package entry with a retired bare `indexes[].unique: true` ⇒ `422`, `INVALID_ARTIFACT_PACKAGE_ENTRY`. Nothing is written.
- CONTROL: a well-formed composed artifact whose renamed field's table read throws ⇒ `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, and nothing is written.
- CONTROL: the same artifact over a readable table ⇒ `200`.
- A dependency cycle between two packages (an undeclared resolver throw) ⇒ rethrown out of the handler, not answered `503`.

No existing test was changed.

<details><summary>Ablation (fix removed ⇒ red), via scripts/ablation-replace.mjs</summary>

Mutation: `            packageUpgradeSideOf(converted);` ⇒ `            /* ABLATION-34432 */` in `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, at commit e6e6b0700. The anchor count went 1 ⇒ 0 and the blob went 8302cb31cf1b ⇒ 07061200e185. The test imports the plugin by relative path (source, not `dist/`), so no rebuild sits in the loop.

- `Tests  3 failed | 2 passed (5)`: both 422 pins received `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` with the card's exact sentence ("the tables its declared rename(s) carry could not be read (A release artifact's `packages` must be an array …) … Retry once the database answers."). The cycle pin received the `503` answer ("… could not be read ([Kernel] Circular dependency detected: com.example.suite.core) …") and no throw.
- Both controls stayed green.
- Restore: `blob after restore 8302cb31cf1b == blob at HEAD`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Where this step is reached first.** The harness mocks `@objectstack/runtime` without `collectJobsWithoutBody` / `collectHooksWithoutBody`. That stands for a runtime that predates the step-1c code judgements, and on such a runtime 2c″ is the first step to resolve the packages. With the real runtime the same two bodies are resolved first at step 1c (`unrunnableCode` ⇒ `collectBundleJobs` ⇒ `resolveArtifactCollections`), and the resolver's refusal leaves the handler as a throw. I measured this by running the same pins once over the real runtime: the throw comes out of `handleInstall` at the `collectJobs(manifest)` call. The Hono transport's error seam (`declaredEnvelopeForThrow`) then answers it `422` with the resolver's code and reports a transport escape. That last part is read from `plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts`, not measured. So on a current runtime the client already saw the `422`, and this PR changes the 2c″ answer for the older-runtime composition. Step 1c answering the refusal itself, as 2b and now 2c″ do, is outside this card.
- **What the 503 still covers.** A throw out of `planDeclaredRenames` after the bodies resolved is answered as the table read. That is the driver's introspection, plus any fault of the plan's own code, which this step has always answered `503`. Telling those two apart needs a marker at the driver call inside `marketplace-install-declared-renames.ts`, which is outside this card's file surface.
- **Read superset.** On a fresh install the pre-resolution also reads `data`, which the plan alone does not read. A composed body the resolver refuses only through `data` is now refused here, before any write. Before, the `manifest` service refused it at register, on the same bytes.
- A dependency cycle between packages of one artifact is a bare `Error` by `resolveArtifactPackageOrder`'s documented contract (`artifact-collections.ts` header). It is rethrown here and, by the transport seam, answered `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` with no cause. Filed: #34574.
- On a re-install the pre-resolution also folds the installed copy (`packageUpgradeSideOf(installed)`). When today's resolver refuses that stored copy, the answer is a 422 that names the incoming package ("Package 'X' cannot be installed"), and that side has no pin of its own. Before this PR the same case answered 503, and step 2c′ folds the installed copy again unguarded, so this is no new dead end, only a misattributed message. Filed: #34583.
